dataset_spec.name: uci_mammographic_mass
dataset_spec.description: UCI Mammographic Mass lesions (961 observations). Predictors are age, shape, margin and density; BI-RADS assessment is excluded as non-predictive per the UCI documentation.
dataset_spec.setting: Mammographic assessment of a breast mass lesion using age and BI-RADS attribute descriptors, before biopsy severity is known.
dataset_spec.observations_header: Patient age and mammographic mass characteristics:

malignancy.question: Based on the patient's age and the reported mammographic mass characteristics, is the lesion benign or malignant?
